text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So many plushies, just for me...
Thank you so much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. More than just happy, a strange sense of peace
washes over my heart, bringing a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It is surely not just because
the plushie is nice to hug, but—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Because it is a heartfelt gift...
That is how it feels to me.
